digest: No automated test suite or fixtures exist (SPEC Q1 violated); only typecheck is defined in package.json; commit 654f639 introduces changes that directly contradict SPEC.md clauses S3, C1, and T3 without any test coverage.

tests.name: unit-tests
tests.description: SPEC.md section Q1 mandates unit tests for each S, C, and T requirement. However, no test directory (e.g., test/, __tests__/), test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts), or test runner configuration exists in the repository.

docs.description: Defines core requirements: stop detection (S1-S7), cancellation classification (C1-C2), terminal summary contract (T1-T3), and test coverage mandate (Q1).
docs.relevance: Direct specification against which the changes in commit 654f639 must be validated. Changes in commit 654f639 conflict with S3, C1, and T3.

docs.description: Specifies package metadata (workflow-stop-sample v0.0.0, private: true, type: module) and notes missing dependencies (store.js and types.js are excluded).
docs.relevance: Identifies the execution boundary and lack of test dependencies/scripts.

releaseArtifacts.name: workflow-stop-sample
releaseArtifacts.description: Package is marked private: true with version 0.0.0; tsconfig.json has noEmit: true, meaning no compiled or distributed npm release artifacts are produced.

validationCommandsMentioned.purpose: Static TypeScript type checking across src/**/*.ts.
validationCommandsMentioned.operationalStatus: Defined script in package.json; standalone execution in isolation would fail unless external stubs for ./store.js and ./types.js are provided as indicated in package description.

knownGaps.summary: Polling interval clamp changed from Math.max(10, options.pollMs ?? 50) to Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200), violating the S3 requirement that default pollMs must be 50ms and lower-bounded at 10ms.
knownGaps.validationState: No test exists to verify pollMs default or clamp bounds.

knownGaps.summary: Cancellation candidate match expanded to accept 'cancelled' and 'timeout', violating C1 which restricts accepted cancellation reasons strictly to 'aborted', 'AbortError', and 'ABORT_ERR'.
knownGaps.validationState: No test exists to enforce strict candidate rejection for non-abort provider errors.

knownGaps.summary: WorkflowTerminalSummary property renamed from launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries, violating T3 which establishes launchRetryAttempts as an immutable public contract consumed by external tools.
knownGaps.validationState: No contract test or schema snapshot exists to prevent regression on public summary property names.

knownGaps.summary: Total absence of automated test harness, fixtures, mocks, or test scripts (Q1 unfulfilled).
knownGaps.validationState: Zero test coverage across all units.

knownGaps.summary: Omission of store.js and types.js in the excerpt prevents clean standalone static type checking without mocked dependencies.
knownGaps.validationState: Typecheck cannot run standalone without mocked modules.
